message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a blue and red color palette. At the top, the red title "TEMPO" is positioned over a dark blue background. Below it, white text reads "BERSIH-BERSIH GANTI MENTERI," followed by smaller white paragraph text.

The main image shows a person seen from the back and side, from the chest up. They have dark hair, tan skin, and wear a collared shirt. This figure holds a black handheld game controller with two analog sticks and several buttons.

The figure is facing a large, glowing blue screen that displays a digital grid environment. On this screen is a wireframe representation of a standing person, outlined in light blue glowing lines. To the left of this wireframe figure, a translucent rectangular panel shows a map of an island. To the right, there are several pointed, white, arrow-like shapes pointing inward from the screen's edge.

Legible text includes "Hashim Djojohadikusumo di PLTA Kayan H.76," "Dugaan Korupsi Baru Riza Chalid H.62," and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." At the bottom, a white box contains a barcode, QR code, and text including "22-28 SEPTEMBER 2025," "RP 60.000," and "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN."
